title: pilosella agathantha
intro: Pilosella agathantha, commonly known as False Sow Thistle, is a plant species within the dandelion family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella agathantha include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, as well as its potential to have antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
